title: Isaac Sim Basics and Photorealistic Simulation
description: This chapter introduces NVIDIA Isaac Sim, a powerful platform for photorealistic robotic simulation and synthetic data generation. Built on NVIDIA Omniverse, Isaac Sim provides a highly realistic environment for developing, testing, and deploying AI-driven robots.
